nodes.label: browser.disconnect() → browser.close() Fix
nodes.rationale: disconnect() leaves Chrome running with userDataDir locked; subsequent headless launch falls back to anonymous session, losing Schoology login. Replaced with close() and wrapped in try/finally to prevent zombie Chrome processes.

nodes.label: Missing/Incomplete Assignment Detection (mapStatus fix)
nodes.rationale: maxGrade guard ran before unsubmitted check; Schoology never renders max-grade for ungraded work so the unsubmitted branch was unreachable dead code — moved unsubmitted check first.

nodes.label: Bold Distinctive Aesthetics Principle
nodes.rationale: Avoid generic AI-generated aesthetics: no overused fonts (Inter, Roboto), no clichéd purple gradients, no predictable layouts. Commit to a bold conceptual direction and execute with precision.

nodes.label: Duplicate Category Bug (hidden report-row fix)
nodes.rationale: Schoology renders each course category twice in .report-row: once real, once in a hidden '(no grading period)' placeholder. Fixed by skipping .report-row elements with the 'hidden' CSS class.

nodes.label: Cookie Replay vs Persistent Profile Architecture Decision
nodes.rationale: Cookie-replay (snapshot once, replay into fresh headless Chrome) silently rejected by Google; migrated to persistent Chrome profile shared between Schoology and Gmail scrapers — proved far more durable against Google bot detection.

Email senders include Princeton Review (summer camp promotion), Schoology (Ashley Stubbs, Carl Walker messages), Google (security alerts), FUHSD Library Notice, Mental Health Resources, Grammarly, and Expertise High School (Locker Clean Out).
